rules.coverage_text: No coverage is specified; treated as all residential rentals in Boston.
rules.quote: An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections
rules.requirement: The bill would authorize the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections. It was accompanied to a study order and no enacted requirements appear in the text.
rules.title: Boston rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections petition
